statement: A collector that quotes repository text into a certificate must quote only its own words. Cejel PR 521 built A4's quoted CI command from every word between the tool and the matched flag, so a token in `uv sync --extra-index-url https://user:<token>@host --locked` reached report.json and certificate.html unredacted under the default rubric, while A2 redacted the same value in the same report. The same PR's v27 detectors made universal claims from co-occurrence: a pytest hook was read as skipping every test because a loop over items and a skip marker both appeared, and a workflow was called publish-only because Cejel did not recognise its verification. Rules: build quoted text from the rule's constants, never the matched input; tie a claim about every item structurally (the marker on the loop variable, every parsed step classified), and let any unclassified step withhold it.
